review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares only two new definitions: rowAdjustedRaw and rowAdjustedLine. Both are problem-specific. rowAdjustedRaw builds the point (l 0, p 1 - floor(l 0) * p 0). rowAdjustedLine applies the project's planarGridFloor to that point. I found no Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core concept that these duplicate. They are built from existing project notions: rowPoint, scalarGridFloor (defined as δ*⌊x/δ⌋) and planarGridFloor. I also looked at the supporting definitions FiniteSeparatedAt, NormalizedFiniteBallBound and TubeIncident. They are defined in other files and are not introduced here. The rest of the file is lemmas about these two definitions, and the rubric excludes lemma duplication. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for alternatives to the imported definitions, so there is some uncertainty there. That is outside this file's scope.
